paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples with a larger number of examples

model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the performance of two methods, ST-ES and Random, in terms of minADE20 as the number of examples varies. The x-axis represents the Number of Examples, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 15, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents minADE20, also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.58 to 0.66, with tick labels at intervals of 0.02. The ST-ES line is depicted in blue with a solid line style and circular markers, starting at approximately 0.665 at 0 examples and decreasing sharply to around 0.58 at 2 examples, then stabilizing around 0.575 from 4 to 15 examples with minor fluctuations. The Random line is shown in orange with a solid line style and circular markers, beginning at about 0.645 at 0 examples, remaining relatively stable around 0.63 from 1 to 15 examples with minor variations.
